operational_failure.root_cause: The Frontier resume dispatch step (.github/workflows/frontier-team.yml, RESUME_FROM branch) performs `git fetch --depth=1 origin <team-branch>:refs/remotes/orin/<team-branch>` followed by `git switch -C operational-resume origin/<team-branch>`. The depth-1 fetch pulled ONLY the tip commit object 8a45c16 as a shallow boundary (.git/shallow listed 8a45c16 plus lane tips), so git treated the tip as a root commit. The full history was NEVER destroyed on the remote; it was merely INVISIBLE to the shallow resume checkout.
